description: Join a dedicated team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD, as an SDC/Infection Control Nurse. This vital full-time role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, providing an excellent opportunity for a skilled professional to make a significant impact on both staff development and patient safety.In this dual-focused position, you will be responsible for coordinating staff education and training programs, ensuring our clinical team maintains the highest standards of care. Concurrently, you will lead our infection prevention and control initiatives, implementing best practices to safeguard the health and well-being of our residents and staff.We are seeking a proactive and knowledgeable RN with a passion for education and a commitment to maintaining a safe environment. If you are ready to contribute your expertise to a supportive and dynamic healthcare setting, we encourage you to apply today.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of experience in a long-term care setting
Demonstrated experience in staff education or development
Proven knowledge and experience in infection prevention and control practices
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $40-$42 per hour.
